how_to_apply: Visit the official website surajpur.gov.in and click on the available online application link for Gram Panchayat Secretary recruitment.
Register or access the online application portal between 16 October 2026 and 03 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM).
Fill out the application form correctly with all required personal and academic details.

Upload self-attested copies of required educational certificates, mark sheets, Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma, local residence certificate, caste certificate, income certificate (for creamy layer exemption where applicable), experience certificate from CEO Zila Panchayat/Janpad Panchayat along with wage calculation sheet, and other necessary documents.
Submit the online application form before the closing date and keep a printout of the submitted application and acknowledgment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under Zila Panchayat Surajpur Gram Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced for the Gram Panchayat Secretary post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the starting date and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 16 October 2026 and closes on 03 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary Board examination and possess a 1-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a government-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a minimum age of 18 years and must not be older than 35 years as on 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply in terms of residence?
faq.answer: Only permanent native residents of Surajpur district are eligible to apply for these vacancies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Surajpur Gram Panchayat Secretary?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on merit calculated from educational marks, higher educational qualifications, computer skill test, and work experience as a Rojgar Sahayak, followed by a computer skill test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for the Gram Panchayat Secretary post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 3500-11000 with a grade pay of Rs. 1100 plus applicable dearness allowance and other allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What is the probation period for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 3 years, which can be extended up to 5 years.
